results.final_message: Fixed `as_compatible_data` in `xarray/core/variable.py` so it only pulls the `.values` attribute from array-like objects (those with an `ndim` attribute, e.g. pandas/xarray objects), rather than from arbitrary scalar objects that merely define `.values`; this makes `Variable.__setitem__`/`.loc` assignments preserve object instances in `dtype=object` arrays. Verified the issue's reproduction now yields `[<HasValues instance>]`, and ran `test_variable.py` (365 passed) plus `test_indexing.py`/`test_dataarray.py` (only pre-existing pandas-version failures remain).

Fixed `DataArray.integrate` so its first argument is now `coord` (matching `Dataset.integrate` and `differentiate`), while keeping `dim` as a deprecated keyword alias that emits a `FutureWarning`; also updated the docstring and added a whats-new entry. Verified with `xarray/tests/test_dataset.py -k integrate` and `TestDataArray::test_computation` (`26 passed, 12 skipped`), plus a direct `coord="x"` call.
